_what: Every Sky130 block ledger scripts/record-sky130-signoff.py writes, its class, and — when its runs are not under tools/OpenLane/designs — the run_root they are under. A ledger is registered, and written with an empty `blocks` map, before its first run: the recorder writes only a registered ledger, and every registered path is a ledger on disk. Locks and flow scripts read ledgers from this list and never by file name (sky130_ledger_registry_lock).

classes.signoff: LOGOS blocks hardened as deliverables: each registered in codegen_sva::signoff_blocks at the period its slow corner meets, and held by every signoff lock.
classes.comparative: The comparative-synthesis bench's candidates, LOGOS and third-party RTL alike, at the period the bench sets: held to provenance, uniqueness, electrical completeness and power binding, never to signoff registration.
